statement: Physical iPhone not connected (xcrun devicectl reported it unavailable). No peak, termination or reclaim number exists. The scenario table and sampling interface below are the executable entry; docs/testing/2026-11-23-ios-rust-extension-memory.md is the human-readable procedure.

t29Corrections.xctraceTemplate: Xcode 27.2 has no 'VM Tracker' template; use --template 'Allocations' --instrument 'VM Tracker'.
t29Corrections.logCollect: log collect uses --device-udid <UDID>; in zsh invoke /usr/bin/log because `log` is a shell builtin.
t29Corrections.statsHostPassthrough: The extension status reply carries stats, but ProviderStatus/BillowMobileBridge.statusDictionary and status/rust.json drop it; ios_vpn_status(engine) has no stats until the host exposes it.

requirements.R3: peak of the whole VPN system extension on a physical iPhone must stay within 40000000 bytes (decimal) in every scenario (startup/config, locked idle, concurrent forwarding, rule-set update, network switch/reconnect), recorded per scenario
requirements.R4: after warm-up, repeated connect/close, rule-set reloads and offline/reconnect rounds return to an equivalent idle state; invalid objects must not accumulate and the idle baseline must not climb

authoritative.metric: physical footprint of the BillowRust process (what memory-pressure termination uses)
authoritative.command: xcrun xctrace record --device <UDID> --template 'VM Tracker' --attach BillowRust --time-limit <N>s --output t7-<scenario>.trace
authoritative.read: Instruments VM Tracker / Debug Navigator Memory gauge

structured.metric: billow_ios_vpn_stats JSON (also in the extension status reply under `stats`)
fields: peakRssBytes (getrusage RUSAGE_SELF ru_maxrss, bytes on Darwin)
structured.use: per-round idle comparison, proof that closed flows/queues return to zero, correlation with the configuration generation

terminationCheck: xcrun devicectl device info processes --device <UDID> | grep -i billowrust
log show t7-jetsam.logarchive --predicate 'eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "jetsam" AND eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "BillowRust"' --last 30m

identityToRecord: app build and manifest version + sha256 (versions/<v>/manifest.json)

scenarios.load: real user configuration: rules, proxy-groups, rule-providers, dns
scenarios.sampling: every 100 ms until startTunnel completion and once at completion

scenarios.load: connected, no traffic, 10 minutes, device locked
8 TCP (HTTPS up/down) + 20 UDP destinations incl. DNS, >= 60 s
reload the same config.yaml 20 times (incl. rule-provider update)
scenarios.r4: generation increments, idle does not climb, no stale generation objects
flows/queues back to zero after reconnect

scenarios.load: connect/close x50, reload x20, offline/reconnect x10, each round returning to idle
scenarios.r4: last-round idle within measurement noise of the first; connection list and queues empty

codeInputs.reload: billow_ios_vpn_reload closes every flow/association, clears the egress queue and increments generation
codeInputs.extensionStatus: ProviderMessageKey.stats in the handleAppMessage status reply

prerequisites: Apple Developer Team with the Network Extension capability and App Group group.app.billow.client for app.billow.client, app.billow.client.mihomo and app.billow.client.rust
controlled TCP/UDP echo endpoint and DNS resolver to prove forwarding continues
host wiring (ios_vpn_* commands + settings entry + resource staging) so both extensions start from the app; not delivered in T7-A1
